levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Five photos, one per station, and in every one the whole part is in frame and in focus.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Five photos with one out of focus, cut off, or too dark to see the feature.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Three or four station photos.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Two station photos or fewer.

criterion: The five stations: Five parts made and photographed

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five records name the tool, how the part was held, and the settings actually used at that machine, in terms specific to that machine.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of the three missing from one record, or one record gives planned values rather than the values run.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One or more missing from two or three records, or those records name the operation only.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Tool, workholding and settings are absent from most records.

criterion: The five stations: Tool, workholding and settings as actually run

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five records name one of these: a problem, a mistake, a measurement that came out wrong, or something changed mid-cut.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Four records name one of those four; one is a general statement such as it went fine.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three records name one of those four.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: One record or none names anything that happened.

criterion: The five stations: What actually happened at the machine

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five drawings uploaded and every word and number on them can be read without zooming.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five present with one that cannot be read without zooming.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Three or four drawings present.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Two drawings or fewer.

criterion: Your five drawings: Drawings present and legible

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five drawings carry every dimension and feature needed to make the part with nothing left to guess, and the topper sketch marks both its 2.5 in limit and its center hole.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One dimension or feature missing from one drawing, or the topper sketch is missing one of its two marks.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Dimensions or features missing from two or three drawings.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Most drawings could not be used to make the part.

criterion: Your five drawings: Manufacturable from the drawing alone

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five rows name a feature and carry both a nominal and a measured value, and the measuring tool is named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Five rows with one missing value, or the measuring tool is not named.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Three or four rows complete.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Two rows or fewer.

criterion: Inspect what you made: Five parts measured and recorded

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the part that came out closest and the one furthest off, quotes a number from the table for each, and gives a physical cause: the tool or beam, how the material behaves, how the part was held, or how the machine moves.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names both and quotes a number, but the cause is correct without being tied to the tool, the material, the workholding or the machine.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Names closest and furthest with no number or no cause.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Does not name which part came out closest and which furthest.

criterion: Inspect what you made: Reading the error

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Photo shows the trophy assembled from all five parts and standing on its own.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Assembled, but the photo does not show all five parts or is too blurred to see them.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Some parts assembled, or the parts are laid out rather than bolted together.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No assembly photo.

criterion: Put it together: Assembled and photographed

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the part and the feature that fought the assembly, or the tightest fit if everything went together, and ties it to how that part was made or measured.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names the part and feature but the reason is general rather than tied to how it was made or measured.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Says whether it fit without naming a part or a feature.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written about the fit.

criterion: Put it together: What the fit told you
